# The Remains of the Day

By Ishiguro.

- The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it.
- Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories.
- Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later.
- Grace recommended it after our conversation about focus.
- The writing is clear and the examples are memorable.
- The audiobook narrator is excellent.
- The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming.
- The main argument is that small habits compound over years.
- Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning.
- It changed how I run the weekly review.
